criteria.Personal_care_products_and_cosmetic_proc: Products, practices, and personal care items related to body grooming, cosmetics, oral hygiene, orthodontic care, and aesthetic procedures (e.g. dental/oral care, skin care, cosmetics, personal hygiene, consumer cosmetic procedures). Excludes medical surgical disease interventions or industrial chemical exposures.
criteria.Substance_use: Substances, medications, addictive chemical agents, or smoking products consumed for recreational, therapeutic, or psychoactive effects (e.g. tobacco products, cigarettes, nicotine, alcoholic beverages, illicit substances, recreational drugs, smoking cessation aids). Excludes standard non-drug food items or dietary nutrients.
criteria.Environmental_exposures: External physical, chemical, or radiological agents and conditions present in workplace, ambient, or indoor air/surroundings (e.g. airborne contaminants, particulate matter PM/SO2, coal burning, ventilation conditions, heavy metals, passive radiation, noise, secondhand smoke, ambient pollutants). Excludes personal voluntary habits like voluntary dietary intake or direct voluntary smoking.
criteria.Mental_health_practices: Psychological interventions, counseling techniques, and therapies aimed at mental wellness, cognitive rehabilitation, or stress management (e.g. psychotherapy, cognitive counseling, play therapy, behavioral therapy techniques, stress management, meditation, mindfulness practices). Excludes psychological disorder diagnoses or psychiatric conditions.
criteria.Non_physical_leisure_time_activities: Sedentary recreational pastimes, play, gambling, digital engagement, hobbies, and non-exertional free-time activities (e.g. gambling, betting, recreational play, screen time, video gaming, social/digital media viewing, reading, non-physical hobbies). Excludes physical exercise, sports, or active outdoor games.
criteria.Nutrition: Foods, beverages, dietary crops, macronutrients, micronutrients, dietary supplements, and dietary intake patterns (e.g. dietary patterns, caloric intake, specific foods, crops, propolis, beans, proteins, carbohydrates, vitamins, minerals, oral dietary supplements). Excludes pharmaceutical drugs, synthetic hospital infusions, or industrial toxins.
criteria.Physical_activities: Muscular bodily movements resulting in energy expenditure, including sports, exercise, strength training, active transport, and measured sedentary time (e.g. exercise routines, strength training, sports, active transport walking/biking, occupational exertion, measured physical activity levels or sitting time). Excludes background demographic settings or passive clinical motor reflexes.
criteria.Sleep: Physiological sleep patterns, sleep duration, sleep quality, sleep deprivation (e.g. REM deprivation), disturbances, and circadian rhythms (e.g. sleep duration, sleep deprivation, REM sleep, napping, sleep continuity, circadian rhythms, daytime alertness or sleepiness). Excludes daytime fatigue resulting strictly from non-sleep medical conditions.
criteria.Socioeconomic_factors: Social, economic, educational, demographic, occupational, and relationship factors influencing health and social standing (e.g. socioeconomic status, income, wealth, education level, employment status, housing, school/play area environments, social support, interpersonal relationships). Excludes individual psychological therapies or voluntary physical exercise habits.
criteria.Non_LSF: Candidate mentions that do not represent an active lifestyle behavior: internal biomarkers/metabolites, disease pathologies, diagnoses, clinical symptoms, demographic attributes, standalone adjectives, generic non-lifestyle terms, clinical trial acronyms/proper nouns, hospital treatments, or background text.
